title: Alternative history — lost civilizations, cataclysms, anomalous engineering
summary: Gather large volumes of open literature and primary material for alternative-history research, then learn from it. Core threads: precision engineering and early monuments in Egypt (Giza, Abydos/Oserion, Heliopolis); Göbekli Tepe and pre-pottery Anatolia; Tiahuanaco / Puma Punku; Younger Dryas impact and megaflood geology (Bretz, Scablands); Atlantis and antediluvian literature (Donnelly onward); comparative flood myths and archaeoastronomy (Hamlet's Mill lineage); classic alternative authors (Hapgood, Schwaller de Lubicz, Tompkins, West, Hancock, Schoch, Bauval, Dunn) alongside the orthodox excavation record they argue against.
